tasks.title: Add cleanup() defensive timeout in acp-session.ts
tasks.description: Wrap the existing `cleanup()` function in `acp-session.ts` (line 551) with a `Promise.race` that adds a 5-second timeout. If stream operations (`readable.cancel`, `writable.abort`) don't settle within 5s, log a warning and proceed to `ensureKill()`. The timeout fires via `setTimeout(resolve, 5000)`.

Normal cleanup (settles within 5s) works unchanged
Typecheck passes
